scenarios.scenario: Visitor opts out (GPC/DNT) or is suppressed after enqueue but before send
scenarios.rationale: prepare_event re-runs evaluate_gates per row immediately before each batch; G9 covers it (integration, pending EVL).

scenarios.scenario: Third-party graph guess (rb2b/leadpipe/beam_identity_network) or company-level guess (hunter/apollo) uploaded as a conversion
scenarios.rationale: FIRST_PARTY_PROVIDERS pinned to {form_capture, pdl_person_enrich}; checked at discovery, enqueue and send. Unit-pinned.

scenarios.scenario: EEA visitor PII sent to Meta without consent
scenarios.rationale: D3: EEA and unknown country skipped for BOTH platforms (fail closed).

scenarios.scenario: Plaintext PII leaking via logs or last_error
scenarios.rationale: last_error holds reason codes or sanitize_error output only; grep proof in verification.json; provider body never persisted.

scenarios.scenario: Cross-tenant read of another site's config/deliveries
scenarios.rationale: verify_site_access on every route returns 404 for foreign sites (G4 foreign-site test, pending EVL).
UNIQUE(site_id, platform, dedup_id) + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; stable row-id dedup (E11) also sent as event_id/transactionId.
per-visitor erasure deletes ad_conversion_deliveries; a pending row whose identity was erased is skipped_erased at send time.
One HTTP call per outbox attempt (no tenacity stacking), backoff min(2^n*60, 3600)s, max attempts 5.
Guarded by optional import: active only once services/company_exclusion.py exists on the merged branch. Merge note: verify the gate is live after both plans land.
